title: sample properties schema
description: Domain-specific fields of a sample entity, mirroring material/material_properties: formula, external and src are kept as they are on a material; basis and lattice are replaced by an optional reference to the nominal material; form, layers, library, position, _parent, composition and identifiers describe the physical specimen.

formula.description: Nominal reduced chemical formula of the sample, or of its top layer for a stack, e.g. Al0.7Sc0.3N

composition.description: Measured or nominal elemental fractions, reusing the elemental ratio property so a composition from XRF and one from a calculation have the same shape.

_material.description: Subset of the full information about the nominal (idealized) material structure of this sample.

_parent.description: Subset of the full information about the sample this one was cut, diced or selected from, e.g. the library a position belongs to.

position.description: Location of this sample on its parent, e.g. which position of a combinatorial library it is.

identifiers.description: Identifiers this sample carries in other systems, e.g. an HTEM sample id or a lab-system run number.

layers.description: Layer stack, ordered from the substrate upward.

library.description: Combinatorial library definition, present when form is library.

external.description: Record of this sample in a third-party database, e.g. HTEM.

src.description: File information if the sample record was imported from a file such as a sample sheet.
